name: ROCm/vllm#630: MXFP4 kernel dispatch fix for garbage output
notes: PR fixes MXFP4 quantization accuracy on ROCm. Issue: garbage output for Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct-MXFP4-Preview. Root cause: wrong kernel dispatch logic. Fix: shuffle weight, remove wrong bias, refine dispatch to use gemm_a4w4 for preshuffled scenario. Verified on MI355X. Demonstrates quantization accuracy loss at scale on ROCm.
